name: Maximus International Limited
about: Maximus International Limited engages in the trading of oils and chemicals in India and internationally. It manufactures and markets lubricant oils, various base oils, and other petro-chemical products for use in automotive, metal working, refrigeration, and paint industries. In addition, it markets and trades in specialty, industrial, and automotive lubricants; specialty chemicals; value-added products; advance formulations; and textile, general equipment, refrigeration, and specialty oils, as well as metals working and electrical fluids. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Vadodara, India. Maximus International Limited operates as a subsidiary of Optimus Finance Limited.
